vsm2.18:18.1: Evaṃ suvisuddharūpapariggahassa panassa arūpadhammā tīhi ākārehi upaṭṭhahanti phassavasena vā vedanāvasena vā viññāṇavasena vā.
vsm2.18:19.1: Ekassa tāva ‘‘pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā’’tiādinā nayena dhātuyo pariggaṇhantassa paṭhamābhinipāto phasso,
vsm2.18:19.3: saddhiṃ phassena cetanā saṅkhārakkhandho, cittaṃ viññāṇakkhandhoti upaṭṭhāti.
vsm2.18:19.4: Tathā ‘‘kese pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā…pe… assāsapassāse pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā’’ti (visuddhi. 1.307) paṭhamābhinipāto phasso,
vsm2.18:19.5: taṃsampayuttā vedanā vedanākkhandho…pe… cittaṃ viññāṇakkhandhoti upaṭṭhāti.
vsm2.18:20.2: taṃsampayuttā saññā saññākkhandho, taṃsampayutto phasso ca cetanā ca saṅkhārakkhandho,
vsm2.18:20.4: Tathā ‘‘kese pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā…pe… assāsapassāse pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā’’ti tadārammaṇarasānubhavanakavedanā vedanākkhandho…pe…
vsm2.18:21.2: taṃsampayuttā vedanā vedanākkhandho, saññā saññākkhandho, phasso ca cetanā ca saṅkhārakkhandhoti upaṭṭhāti.
vsm2.18:21.3: Tathā ‘‘kese pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā…pe… assāsapassāse pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā’’ti ārammaṇapaṭivijānanaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho,
vsm2.18:21.4: taṃsampayuttā vedanā vedanākkhandho, saññā saññākkhandho, phasso ca cetanā ca saṅkhārakkhandhoti upaṭṭhāti.
vsm2.18:22.1: Eteneva upāyena ‘‘kammasamuṭṭhāne kese pathavīdhātu kakkhaḷalakkhaṇā’’tiādinā nayena dvācattālīsāya dhātukoṭṭhāsesu catunnaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ vasena,
vsm2.18:22.2: sesesu ca cakkhudhātuādīsu rūpapariggahamukhesu sabbaṃ nayabhedaṃ anugantvā yojanā kātabbā.
vsm2.18:23.1: Yasmā ca evaṃ suvisuddharūpapariggahasseva tassa arūpadhammā tīhākārehi pākaṭā honti.
vsm2.18:23.2: Tasmā suvisuddharūpapariggaheneva arūpapariggahāya yogo kātabbo, na itarena.
vsm2.18:23.3: Sace hi ekasmiṃ vā rūpadhamme upaṭṭhite dvīsu vā rūpaṃ pahāya arūpapariggahaṃ ārabhati kammaṭṭhānato parihāyati,
vsm2.18:23.5: Suvisuddharūpapariggahassa pana arūpapariggahāya yogaṃ karoto kammaṭṭhānaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti.
vsm2.18:24.1: So evaṃ phassādīnaṃ vasena upaṭṭhite cattāro arūpino khandhe nāmanti,
vsm2.18:24.2: tesaṃ ārammaṇabhūtāni cattāri mahābhūtāni, catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāyarūpaṃ rūpanti vavatthapeti.
vsm2.18:24.3: Iti aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo dvādasāyatanāni pañcakkhandhāti sabbepi tebhūmake dhamme khaggena samuggaṃ vivaramāno viya yamakatālakandaṃ phālayamāno viya ca
vsm2.18:24.5: Nāmarūpamattato uddhaṃ añño satto vā puggalo vā devo vā brahmā vā natthīti niṭṭhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.18:25.1: So evaṃ yāthāvasarasato nāmarūpaṃ vavatthapetvā suṭṭhutaraṃ ‘‘satto puggalo’’ti imissā lokasamaññāya pahānatthāya sattasammohassa samatikkamatthāya asammohabhūmiyaṃ cittaṃ ṭhapanatthāya
vsm2.18:25.2: sambahulasuttantavasena ‘‘nāmarūpamattamevidaṃ, na satto, na puggalo atthī’’ti etamatthaṃ saṃsandetvā vavatthapeti.
vsm2.18:25.4:
‘‘Yathāpi aṅgasambhārā, hoti saddo ratho iti;
Evaṃ khandhesu santesu, hoti sattoti sammutī’’ti. (saṃ. ni. 1.171);
vsm2.18:26.1: Aparampi vuttaṃ, ‘‘seyyathāpi, āvuso, kaṭṭhañca paṭicca valliñca paṭicca mattikañca paṭicca tiṇañca paṭicca ākāso parivārito agārantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
vsm2.18:26.2: evameva kho, āvuso, aṭṭhiñca paṭicca nhāruñca paṭicca maṃsañca paṭicca cammañca paṭicca ākāso parivārito rūpantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.306).
vsm2.18:27.2:
‘‘Dukkhameva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca;
Nāññatra dukkhā sambhoti, nāññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī’’ti. (saṃ. ni. 1.171);
vsm2.18:28.1: Evaṃ anekasatehi suttantehi nāmarūpameva dīpitaṃ, na satto na puggalo.
vsm2.18:28.2: Tasmā yathā akkhacakkapañjaraīsādīsu aṅgasambhāresu ekenākārena saṇṭhitesu rathoti vohāramattaṃ hoti, paramatthato ekekasmiṃ aṅge upaparikkhiyamāne ratho nāma natthi.
vsm2.18:28.3: Yathā ca kaṭṭhādīsu gehasambhāresu ekenākārena ākāsaṃ parivāretvā ṭhitesu gehanti vohāramattaṃ hoti, paramatthato gehaṃ nāma natthi.
vsm2.18:28.4: Yathā ca aṅguliaṅguṭṭhādīsu ekenākārena ṭhitesu muṭṭhīti vohāramattaṃ hoti. Doṇitantiādīsu vīṇāti. Hatthiassādīsu senāti. Pākāragehagopurādīsu nagaranti.
vsm2.18:28.5: Khandhasākhāpalāsādīsu ekenākārena ṭhitesu rukkhoti vohāramattaṃ hoti, paramatthato ekekasmiṃ avayave upaparikkhiyamāne rukkho nāma natthi.
vsm2.18:28.6: Evamevaṃ pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu sati ‘‘satto, puggalo’’ti vohāramattaṃ hoti, paramatthato ekekasmiṃ dhamme upaparikkhiyamāne ‘‘asmīti vā ahanti vā’’ti gāhassa vatthubhūto satto nāma natthi.
vsm2.18:28.8: Evaṃ passato hi dassanaṃ yathābhūtadassanaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.18:29.1: Yo panetaṃ yathābhūtadassanaṃ pahāya ‘‘satto atthī’’ti gaṇhāti. So tassa vināsaṃ anujāneyya avināsaṃ vā.
vsm2.18:29.5: Khīranvayassa dadhino viya tadanvayassa aññassa abhāvato.
vsm2.18:29.6: So ‘‘sassato satto’’ti gaṇhanto olīyati nāma. ‘‘Ucchijjatī’’ti gaṇhanto atidhāvati nāma.
vsm2.18:30.1: Tenāha bhagavā – ‘‘Dvīhi, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigatehi pariyuṭṭhitā devamanussā olīyanti eke, atidhāvanti eke, cakkhumanto ca passanti.
vsm2.18:30.2: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke? Bhavārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasamuditā.
vsm2.18:30.3: Tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke.
vsm2.18:30.4: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, atidhāvanti eke? Bhaveneva kho paneke aṭṭīyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti,
vsm2.18:30.5: yato kira bho ayaṃ attā kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti paraṃmaraṇā, etaṃ santaṃ, etaṃ paṇītaṃ, etaṃ yāthāvanti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atidhāvanti eke.
vsm2.18:30.6: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, cakkhumanto passanti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhūtaṃ bhūtato passati,
vsm2.18:30.7: bhūtaṃ bhūtato disvā bhūtassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cakkhumanto passantī’’ti (itivu. 49).
vsm2.18:31.1: Tasmā yathā dāruyantaṃ suññaṃ nijjīvaṃ nirīhakaṃ, atha ca pana dārurajjukasamāyogavasena gacchatipi tiṭṭhatipi. Saīhakaṃ sabyāpāraṃ viya khāyati,
vsm2.18:31.2: evamidaṃ nāmarūpampi suññaṃ nijjīvaṃ nirīhakaṃ, atha ca pana aññamaññasamāyogavasena gacchatipi tiṭṭhatipi. Saīhakaṃ sabyāpāraṃ viya khāyatīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
vsm2.18:31.3: Tenāhu porāṇā – ‘‘Nāmañca rūpañca idhatthi saccato, Na hettha satto manujo ca vijjati; Suññaṃ idaṃ yantamivābhisaṅkhataṃ, Dukkhassa puñjo tiṇakaṭṭhasādiso’’ti.
vsm2.18:32.1: Na kevalañcetaṃ dāruyantupamāya, aññāhipi naḷakalāpīādīhi upamāhi vibhāvetabbaṃ –
vsm2.18:32.2: yathā hi dvīsu naḷakalāpīsu aññamaññaṃ nissāya ṭhapitāsu ekā ekissā upatthambho hoti, ekissā patamānāya itarāpi patati,
vsm2.18:32.3: evamevaṃ pañcavokārabhave nāmarūpaṃ aññamaññaṃ nissāya pavattati, ekaṃ ekassa upatthambho hoti. Maraṇavasena ekasmiṃ patamāne itarampi patati.
vsm2.18:32.4: Tenāhu porāṇā – ‘‘Yamakaṃ nāmarūpañca, ubho aññoññanissitā; Ekasmiṃ bhijjamānasmiṃ, ubho bhijjanti paccayā’’ti.
vsm2.18:33.1: Yathā ca daṇḍābhihataṃ bheriṃ nissāya sadde pavattamāne aññā bherī, añño saddo, bherisaddā asammissā, bherī saddena suññā, saddo bheriyā suñño,
vsm2.18:33.2: evamevaṃ vatthudvārārammaṇasaṅkhātaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya nāme pavattamāne aññaṃ rūpaṃ, aññaṃ nāmaṃ, nāmarūpā asammissā, nāmaṃ rūpena suññaṃ, rūpaṃ nāmena suññaṃ,
vsm2.18:33.3: apica kho bheriṃ paṭicca saddo viya rūpaṃ paṭicca nāmaṃ pavattati.
vsm2.18:33.4: Tenāhu porāṇā – ‘‘Na cakkhuto jāyare phassapañcamā, Na rūpato no ca ubhinnamantarā; Hetuṃ paṭiccappabhavanti saṅkhatā, Yathāpi saddo pahaṭāya bheriyā.
vsm2.18:33.5: ‘‘Na sotato jāyare phassapañcamā, Na saddato no ca ubhinnamantarā…pe…. ‘‘Na ghānato jāyare phassapañcamā, Na gandhato no ca ubhinnamantarā…pe….
vsm2.18:33.6: ‘‘Na jivhāto jāyare phassapañcamā, Na rasato no ca ubhinnamantarā…pe…. ‘‘Na kāyato jāyare phassapañcamā, Na phassato no ca ubhinnamantarā…pe….
vsm2.18:33.7: ‘‘Na vatthurūpā pabhavanti saṅkhatā, Na cāpi dhammāyatanehi niggatā; Hetuṃ paṭiccappabhavanti saṅkhatā, Yathāpi saddo pahaṭāya bheriyā’’ti.
vsm2.18:34.1: Apicettha nāmaṃ nittejaṃ na sakena tejena pavattituṃ sakkoti, na khādati, na pivati, na byāharati, na iriyāpathaṃ kappeti.
vsm2.18:34.2: Rūpampi nittejaṃ na sakena tejena pavattituṃ sakkoti.
vsm2.18:34.3: Na hi tassā khāditukāmatā, nāpi pivitukāmatā, na byāharitukāmatā, na iriyāpathaṃ kappetukāmatā, atha kho nāmaṃ nissāya rūpaṃ pavattati, rūpaṃ nissāya nāmaṃ pavattati,
vsm2.18:34.4: nāmassa khāditukāmatāya pivitukāmatāya byāharitukāmatāya iriyāpathaṃ kappetukāmatāya sati rūpaṃ khādati, pivati, byāharati, iriyāpathaṃ kappeti.
vsm2.18:35.1: Imassa panatthassa vibhāvanatthāya imaṃ upamaṃ udāharanti –
vsm2.18:35.2: yathā jaccandho ca pīṭhasappī ca disāpakkamitukāmā assu,
vsm2.18:35.3: jaccandho pīṭhasappiṃ evamāha ‘‘ahaṃ kho bhaṇe, sakkomi pādehi pādakaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ, natthi ca me cakkhūni yehi samavisamaṃ passeyya’’nti.
vsm2.18:35.4: Pīṭhasappīpi jaccandhaṃ evamāha ‘‘ahaṃ kho bhaṇe, sakkomi cakkhunā cakkhukaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ, natthi ca me pādāni yehi abhikkameyyaṃ vā paṭikkameyyaṃ vā’’ti.
vsm2.18:35.5: So tuṭṭhahaṭṭho jaccandho pīṭhasappiṃ aṃsakūṭaṃ āropesi.
vsm2.18:35.6: Pīṭhasappī jaccandhassa aṃsakūṭe nisīditvā evamāha ‘‘vāmaṃ muñca dakkhiṇaṃ gaṇha, dakkhiṇaṃ muñca vāmaṃ gaṇhā’’ti.
vsm2.18:35.7: Tattha jaccandhopi nittejo dubbalo na sakena tejena sakena balena gacchati,
vsm2.18:35.8: pīṭhasappīpi nittejo dubbalo na sakena tejena sakena balena gacchati,
vsm2.18:35.9: na ca tesaṃ aññamaññaṃ nissāya gamanaṃ nappavattati,
vsm2.18:35.10: evamevaṃ nāmampi nittejaṃ na sakena tejena uppajjati, na tāsu tāsu kiriyāsu pavattati.
vsm2.18:35.11: Rūpampi nittejaṃ na sakena tejena uppajjati, na tāsu tāsu kiriyāsu pavattati,
vsm2.18:35.12: na ca tesaṃ aññamaññaṃ nissāya uppatti vā pavatti vā na hoti.
vsm2.18:36.1: Tenetaṃ vuccati – ‘‘Na sakena balena jāyare, Nopi sakena balena tiṭṭhare; Paradhammavasānuvattino, Jāyare saṅkhatā attadubbalā.
vsm2.18:36.2: ‘‘Parapaccayato ca jāyare, Paraārammaṇato samuṭṭhitā; Ārammaṇapaccayehi ca, Paradhammehi cime pabhāvitā.
vsm2.18:36.3: ‘‘Yathāpi nāvaṃ nissāya, manussā yanti aṇṇave; Evameva rūpaṃ nissāya, nāmakāyo pavattati.
vsm2.18:36.4: ‘‘Yathā ca manusse nissāya, nāvā gacchati aṇṇave; Evameva nāmaṃ nissāya, rūpakāyo pavattati.
vsm2.18:36.5: ‘‘Ubho nissāya gacchanti, manussā nāvā ca aṇṇave; Evaṃ nāmañca rūpañca, ubho aññoññanissitā’’ti.
vsm2.18:37.1: Evaṃ nānānayehi nāmarūpaṃ vavatthāpayato sattasaññaṃ abhibhavitvā asammohabhūmiyaṃ ṭhitaṃ nāmarūpānaṃ yāthāvadassanaṃ diṭṭhivisuddhīti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.18:37.3:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Paññābhāvanādhikāre
Diṭṭhivisuddhiniddeso nāma
Aṭṭhārasamo paricchedo.
